messages:
alex_g: Heads-up — noticing some surprising cache "savings" numbers on the econ dashboard for multi-model pipelines. Example: request goes to model-A (priming), then model-B consumes the prefix and gets a KV cache hit that saves ~200 tokens. Dashboard currently credits model-B with the savings even though model-A generated the prefix. We should decide attribution rules. Thoughts? :thinking:

maria_prod: Is this for the chains that our customers call via the /chain API or internal pipelines? cc @chris_platform

chris_platform: Both. Right now our billing pipeline attributes cache credits to the model instance that served the hit. That inflates models that are effectively consumers of other models' outputs. It's misleading for per-model unit-econ comparisons.

sasha_eng: Quick idea: attribute saved tokens back to the model that generated the cached prefix (origin model). If multiple models contributed to the prefix, split by token-origin trace. That preserves econometrics of which model produced the work that created the cache.

lee_fin: From invoicing / chargeback POV customers want predictable, simple rules. Complex proportional splits will be hard to explain. Prefer deterministic, auditable rules — e.g., "first-generator wins" or "highest-cost generator wins".

chris_platform: "First-generator wins" is simple and deterministic, but it can under-credit downstream models that were actually reused. Another option: weight the credit by model token rate (sku price) so a cheaper generator doesn't take all the credit.

alex_g: We need telemetry first. Router should emit minimal trace info so we can reconstruct origin. Proposal for proxy event fields (we'll collect this in request-level telemetry):

```
request_id: <uuid>
chain_trace: ["model-A:gen:150", "model-B:call:12"]
cache_events: [
  { model: "model-B", tokens_saved: 200, origin_tokens: [ {model: "model-A", tokens: 150} ] }
]
```

We can then run attribution heuristics in the billing/telemetry backend.

ops-bot: Note: adding new telemetry fields will require schema bump and minor traffic. Ensure feature flags.

sasha_eng: Implementation note: the edge/router is best place to attach origin metadata (X-Cache-Origin or X-Model-Origin header) at request materialization time. The runtime already knows which model produced which KV entries.

maria_prod: UX ask: console should surface both "gross" model savings (what model consumed) and "attributed" savings (what we allocate after heuristics). Add a toggle for internal vs customer view and an explanation tooltip. Also add a simple histogram showing how much credit shifts under each heuristic.

lee_fin: +1 on toggle. For external invoices stick to the deterministic rule we pick (so customers don't get surprised). Internal view can show experimental splits. Need CSV export and an appeals/audit endpoint.

chris_platform: Proposed action items:
1) Define attribution heuristics (first-generator, sku-weighted, proportional token-origin) + deterministic fallback.
2) Telemetry schema for cache events and chain traces.
3) Prototype attribution computation over last 30 days to measure delta.
4) Console mock + toggle + CSV/export.

Can volunteers pick items?

alex_g: I can drive 1 + 2. I'll write a short design doc with examples and edgecases (cross-tenant prefixes, reused public prompts).

sasha_eng: I can run 3 (prototype) — will need a sampled historic trace and we'll stub origin headers for replay. I'll aim for a small POC that outputs per-model deltas. :+1:

maria_prod: I'll do 4 — mockups tomorrow. Default for billing export = first-generator. Internal toggle will let us flip heuristics while we evaluate. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Epic created: RED-4321 "heuristic cache attribution".

alex_g: Cool. One more ask: let's include a tiny fallback rule when origin is missing (sticky routing: attribute to the route's primary model). We'll document this in the design doc.

chris_platform: Agreed. Also add a short dev note: any attribution that relies on origin headers must be conservative — don't let a missing header cause negative credits.

sasha_eng: I'll ping infra for a sampled dataset and start replay tests.

lee_fin: Keep finance in loop when we run the historical sim — call out estimated revenue impact before any rollouts.

alex_g: Thanks all — will post the design doc link in this thread once it's up.
